lines.t: C'mon United!

The team's nickname. It starts like 'high', not 'hip'.

Eddie Turnbull's exciting side of the early 1970s.

memory: 1965: Killie won their only league title on the last day, beating Hearts 2-0 at Tynecastle

The club's other nickname, and a dig at Ayr United.
